newsitem.title: Singapore: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.
"Rates were a little bit mixed in the morning on lack of fresh factors and most people were sitting on the sidelines reluctant to open or hold new positions," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for Wednesday's report on consumer prices for September, for more clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day dates, Monday/Tuesday and Tuesday/Wednesday rose 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Week-fixed was unchanged from last Friday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months eased 1/16 point to 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and twelve-months slipped half a point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.
